attBesluta.text: Excellent addition to my tool collection. I've always needed one but usually borrowed from brothers. Now I have my own set!!
Best tap set I’ve ever purchased. Molded case holds everything very securely and has sizes embedded next to each piece.

one of the most complete tap and die sets with metric and american sizes and thread pitches

this is the 3rd set of 116 piece tap & dies I have purchased because Vevor has put together great quality & excellent prices that I bought my son in-law. actually I gave him my set so he could finish his stainless steal deck hand rail.Then my son saw the second set, and I realized he needed set to carry in his race trailer for he races A Dirttrack USRA B-Mod 2&3 times a week & he can be hard on parts! I Actually told him we can fix what he breaks but first ya GOT- TO FINISH! he s been winning more than I ever could!! He s putting me to shame!! That's OK. At least he s got great tools to speed up any repairs from VEVOR!! THANK-YOU-ALL,!!
